verdict.rationale: gstack ships SKILL.md files and supports many hosts (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and others). But that portability comes from a per-host TypeScript config generator, not from documented conformance to the open Agent Skills specification. Nothing in the evidence states that one skill folder is spec-valid across tools, so the multi-host generator counts only as an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As a developer, skills follow the open Agent Skills specification so the same skill folder is valid beyond this one vendor's tooling
